metadata.title: Harmonic Map Heat Flow Coupled to a Green-Potential
metadata.abstract: We introduce a Green--potential heat flow for maps from a closed Riemannian surface. Inspired by Parker--Wolfson renormalization~\cite{ParkerWolfson1993,Parker1996}, the conformal factor is reconstructed at each time from an energy-based source determined by the current map. The resulting parabolic--elliptic system incorporates renormalization into the evolution while leaving the Dirichlet energy functional and its harmonic critical points unchanged. We establish local well-posedness for $H^3$ initial data and a continuation criterion in terms of energy concentration. For sufficiently large coupling, we exclude finite-time bubbling and obtain global solutions. At infinite time, the energy identity provides only weighted $L^2$ control of the tension field. Localizing to regular regions of concentration charts yields harmonic profiles along subsequences of prescribed times. We represent these profiles in the flow's packet charts, organize them into a finite bubble tree, and decompose the limiting energy into harmonic component energies and neck energies. A critically normalized radial example illustrates how the modified flow can prevent finite-time blow-up and produce harmonic bubbles with no-neck property.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: Green 势耦合调和映射热流
analysis.workSummary: 从当前映射能量重建共形因子，建立抛物—椭圆耦合流；充分大耦合排除有限时间冒泡，并研究无穷时泡树分解。
analysis.breakthrough: 保持 Dirichlet 能量及调和临界点，同时以演化内置重整化抑制有限时爆破。
analysis.limitations: 无穷时仅有加权张力控制；一般分解保留颈部能量，示例中的无颈性质不能推广到所有解。
